tools.name: chat
tools.description: Run a chat completion on the Fermat gateway, paid from the Phase API key or the wallet this server uses (free models cost nothing). Returns the answer, actual price, task id for the receipt and usage.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Run one prompt on 2 to 4 Fermat models or classes at once and compare answer, price, tokens and speed; returns the cheapest, the most expensive and how many times more the expensive one cost. Spends credit for each model. Default models: the cheapest paid chat model, auto, and the most expensive ope

tools.name: docs
tools.description: Fermat documentation in short: connect, pricing (with the live price table), savings, mcp, byok, data, receipts, limits.

tools.name: embed
tools.description: Compute embeddings on the Fermat gateway (paid from the Phase API key or the wallet).

tools.name: key
tools.description: Balance, daily cap and spend of the Phase API key this server pays with (key mode).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List models of the Fermat gateway with prices (USD per 1M tokens, fee per call) and layer (flagship | open | class | free).

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Get the price ceiling for a chat request without paying (the gateway's 402 quote).

tools.name: receipt
tools.description: Fetch the public receipt of a paid request by task id (model, provider, tokens, price, settlement tx, request/response hashes, signatures) and its Merkle proof once the weekly epoch is closed.

tools.name: route_explain
tools.description: Explain one Fermat request from its public receipt: the model or class it named, the complexity level, the model and provider that served it, the price, the price of the class baseline model and the saving in percent, and the providers tried.

tools.name: session
tools.description: Saved chat sessions on the Fermat gateway: create one (returns an id and a shareable /s/<id> link), read its thread, list the wallet's sessions (wallet mode only: signed with the wallet key, no transaction), or delete one. Pass the id as `session` to chat and the gateway carries the context between

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Spend and savings of the Fermat API key over the last N days (1 to 90, default 7): totals, per day and per model when the gateway has the history (source usage), otherwise the key's totals (source key). Key mode only.
